p5-mayapay.title: The Climb up Mount Mayapay
p5-mayapay.text: On Saturday, Joy and her big brother Carlo went to Mount Mayapay. They brought water, bread and a small map. The trail was steep and rocky. Joy felt tired, so they rested under a tall tree. Carlo gave her some water. “We are almost there,” he said. Joy smiled and kept walking. At the top, the wind was cool. They could see the Agusan River shining like a silver ribbon far below. Joy took a deep breath. “This was worth it!” she said. Before the sun went down, they walked back home together.

p5-boat.title: Mia's Paper Boat
p5-boat.text: Mia made a paper boat from an old notebook page. She drew a red star on its sail. After the rain stopped, she ran to the small canal near her house. She put the boat on the water. The boat floated and turned slowly. Then the water pushed it fast! Mia ran along the canal to follow it. Suddenly, the boat got stuck between two stones. Mia used a long stick to free it. The boat sailed again. Mia laughed and clapped her hands. “Tomorrow, I will make two more boats,” she said.
